resources.string: GitHub lets apps attach files only to repositories you can write to, and you cannot write to %1$s.\n\nOpen the page on github.com and attach the file there; you can drag it into the text box or tap \"Paste, drop, or click to add files\".
GitHub does not take this kind of file: %1$s.\n\nPictures: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, SVG. Videos: MP4, MOV, WebM.
%1$s is bigger than 10 MB, the largest picture GitHub takes.
%1$s is bigger than 100 MB, the largest video GitHub takes (10 MB on the Free plan).
GitHub refused the upload (404). This happens when you cannot write to %1$s.\n\nOpen the page on github.com and attach the file there.
GitHub did not accept this sign-in for uploads (HTTP %1$d: %2$s).\n\nOpen the page on github.com and attach the file there.
GitHub asks to wait before the next upload (Retry-After: %1$s). Try again later.
GitHub took the file but sent no link back. Try again.
GitHub did not say which repository this is. Try again.

The phone could not play this video (%1$s). GitHub keeps a new upload private until the comment that uses it is sent, and some formats cannot be played by every phone.\n\nOpen it in the browser instead?
